text: Your coding agent is brilliant on day one and lost by day thirty. The fix isn't waiting for a smarter model; it's a harness of rules, tiered context, and durable memory files that stop the agent from forgetting its own decisions.

A new credential appears in public code about every two seconds. With AI agents pushing code faster than humans can review, manual secret revocation can't keep up. Platforms are moving protection upstream with context-aware classifiers.

Oracle reports turning multi-day recruitment and engineering workflows into minutes using ChatGPT Work and Codex. The team emphasizes that you still have to own the code and provide working prototypes instead of abstract specs.

Jump Trading uses GPT-6 Astra for long-running quantitative research workflows. The firm combines multi-source data analysis with human review to ensure complex predictive models stay compliant and accurate.
